statement: A .conf atlas file is text: '[Frame]', 'Count = N', then N lines 'FrameK = (name x y w h)' with integer x,y,w,h parsed by atoi; each becomes a frame named name+'Frame' with Rect(x,y,w,h) on texture <dir>/<base>Image? loaded as .pvr when flag set else .png. Consumer: DinoCap::loadImageByConf @0x59ad6.
All 118 .a2b and 32 .c2b in DC2 data parse with DC1's grammar and round-trip byte-exact. Grammar only, not field meaning.

.an2 files are XML keyframe animation text (AnimFrame/Sprite: x,y,width,height,offsetX,offsetY,rotation(deg),layer,color,image); each has a same-path .a2b with more (baked) frames. Where keyframes match, a2b A,B=offsetX,offsetY; C=rotation in radians; packedRGBA=color; D=layer (1866/1941 keyframe parts); ref=image. An2 is NOT always in sync with shipped a2b (1277/1941 full numeric match; eff_fan1 differs) so it is authoring-side evidence, not runtime truth. The binary also contains the strings Image/an2/p_hit.an2 and p_roll.an2 (xrefs sub_69DE6, sub_6D54A) - runtime use unproven. UPDATE: CombineAnimation::LoadXmlFromFile@0xc4da (despite its name) reads a BINARY file via ReadData+BlockReadBuffer (u32 frame count then CAFrame::LoadXmlFromFile@0xc404 per frame) from paths ending .a2b (e.g. Image/an2/load_p1_fire.a2b). So the title-screen hero animations load the binary .a2b, not the XML .an2. XML .an2 runtime use remains only for strings p_hit.an2/p_roll.an2 (sub_69DE6, sub_6D54A) - still to check. UPDATE 2: PROVEN: global resource init sub_69DE6 (0x69de6) loads Image/an2/p_hit.an2 and p_roll.an2 with CombineAnimation::LoadXml (tinyxml, keyframes) followed by CombineAnimation::Expand(1.0) / Expand(1.5) (interpolates keyframes into per-frame data), while p_move/p_stand/p_fire/p_behit/p_house/pd_*/p_die/p2_roll*/p_stand_j/qh2/eff_fan*/levelup_eff* are loaded with LoadXmlFromFile (binary a2b read). So the shipped .an2 XML is runtime data for p_hit and p_roll (the other .an2 are authoring leftovers).

Other shipped formats: .acb (72; binary, magic 0x3EA then '<name>.library' string) = new animation-library format not in DC1; .pvr (16; PVR v2 header size 0x34 + 'PVR!'); .font (3; INI text with height and chars); .prop/.xml (config).
